checklist.why: Purpose present; no sibling named (Row for an editable record, TaskReceipt for a day receipt).
Parts named, but the preview does not show extraHtml or the candidate group description.
The categorised log (a kind word over each entry, kind filters above) is a real variant on two screens and is not documented as one.
Empty state is stated but not rendered in the preview.
Label and meta formats stated, but hosts break them (see findings) and there is no long-entry example.
No role stated (sections and articles; is it a list?).
Raw #cbd6c2 thread, #849b72 dot, 7px, 18px and 13/11/10/9px type in bundle.css; the README names log-dot and log-line tokens the CSS does not use.
No classification line or related links.
Only the default state is rendered at 375; no proof of the empty state.

variants.name: day log (plain)
findings: farrowing.history repeats "Farrowing finished" as title and detail; piglet-processing.pen-log writes one entry per piglet ID (8 lines of "ID 0012xx").

variants.name: categorised log
findings: Prints "Author not supplied"; group labels mix "1 Aug 2026" and "Before this walk".

findings.text: Budget in use: piglet-processing.pen-log lists every ID as its own entry (ID 001201 ... ID 001208), and farrowing.history says "Farrowing finished" twice in one entry.
findings.fix: Add a rule and an example: one recorded act is one entry ("8 IDs · 001201-001208"); detail never repeats the title. Fix the two hosts.

findings.text: Hosts write group labels and meta four ways: "5 days ago", "day 4", "1 Aug 2026", "Before this walk"; meta "G.H · 10/07 10:07" vs "14:02 · L. Madsen" vs "G. Hansen".
findings.fix: Pin the format in the component: meta = time · initials (the group label carries the date); group labels = Today / Yesterday / weekday / "Jul 8". Take a date and initials as data, not free strings.

findings.text: The categorised log is a real variant (pig-profile.log, inspection.pen-log) without its own when-to-use.
findings.fix: Document it: use category only when one log mixes kinds of event and offers a kind filter; otherwise use the plain log.

findings.text: Missing data is printed as text ("Author not supplied"), though the content law says missing is absent.
findings.fix: Add a Don't: drop an empty meta part; never print a placeholder.

findings.text: Raw colours and sizes; the log-dot and log-line tokens are named in the README but not used in CSS.
findings.fix: Use var(--log-dot), var(--log-line) and the type tokens.

findings.text: Empty state is not rendered in the preview.
findings.fix: Add a second preview case, log([]), showing "No activity recorded yet".

proposals.name: Log: categorised
proposals.why: Same job (history tail), different structure (kind word, kind filter); used on two screens.
